About The Opportunity

 A fast-scaling IT services and digital transformation partner operating across BFSI, healthcare, and manufacturing sectors, we help enterprises modernize their IT service management (ITSM) and enterprise workflow automation using ServiceNow’s industry-leading platform. Our clients rely on us to design, build, and sustain scalable, secure, and user-centric ServiceNow solutions—delivered by passionate developers who turn complex business needs into seamless digital experiences.

 Role & Responsibilities

 • Design, develop, and deploy custom ServiceNow applications, workflows, and modules aligned with ITIL and business process standards.
• Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and third-party systems (e.g., Active Directory, SAP, Salesforce, Jira) using REST/SOAP APIs and MID Server.
• Configure and customize ServiceNow UIs (UI Policies, Client Scripts, UI Actions, Catalog Items) to enhance user experience and adoption.
• Implement automation using Flow Designer, Business Rules, and Script Includes to drive operational efficiency across incident, change, and request management.
• Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, translate them into technical specs, and deliver scalable, maintainable solutions within sprint cycles.
• Perform system upgrades, troubleshoot production issues, and ensure code quality via unit testing, peer reviews, and ServiceNow best practices.

 Skills & Qualifications

 Must-Have

 • ServiceNow Platform Development
• ServiceNow Application Development
• JavaScript
• ServiceNow Integration (REST/SOAP/MID Server)
• ServiceNow ITSM Modules
• ServiceNow Flow Designer
• ServiceNow Client Scripts / UI Policies
• ServiceNow System Configuration

 Preferred

 • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
• Experience with ServiceNow Performance Analytics or Discovery
• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology and CI/CD pipelines

 Benefits & Culture Highlights

 • On-site workspace in premier business parks with modern infrastructure.
• Opportunity to work on high-impact, client-facing ServiceNow implementations across global industries.
• Flexible learning hours, certification support, and career growth paths aligned with ServiceNow ecosystem mastery.

 About The Role

 CrowdStrike IT is growing and seeking a dynamic ServiceNow Administrator / Developer to join the ServiceNow Support Team. Along with your team members, you will be responsible for the overall ServiceNow experience at CrowdStrike.

The ServiceNow Administrator will focus primarily on platform support, administration and Incident handling, but will have opportunities to grow development skills on projects and enhancements. This individual will work with ServiceNow Architects and Developers on related projects including service automation and platform integration support. A typical day will include working from both a platform Incident queue, assisting with admin tasks such as patching, cloning, upgrades and deployments as well as participating in development projects. Other duties as assigned.

 What You’ll Do:

 • Administering capabilities to configure the ServiceNow platform to align with IT best practice.
• Platform upgrades and code migration via update sets
• Configuring and administering the ServiceNow platform user interface, screen elements, work flows, mobile interfaces, plugins and branding
• Managing and administering lists, filters, forms, platform interfaces (to other data sources) and the data within tables, import sets and the CMDB
• Managing and administering ServiceNow users, groups, user criteria, and all the various roles
• Assisting the Service Management Office Team in developing, building, testing, deploying and updating items within the Service Catalogue and corresponding items in the Self-Service Portal
• Configuring and maintaining application security 
• Development work on stories for enhancements and project implementations across platform modules
• Code reviews of other Developers’ work
• Assisting with monitoring and improving platform health
• Administering ServiceNow applications, including updating security and workflow configurations, importing data, creating custom scripts, and building reports
• Creating alerts and notifications using e-mail and other messaging capabilities within the platform
• Ensuring the best performance from the system
• Troubleshooting, resolving and /or escalating system Incidents when they arise
• Performing daily operational management and administration activities 
• Producing reports and dashboards based on defined measures, metrics and key performance indicators. Recommending any improvements regarding the platform, processes or reporting
• Ensuring policies are reflected in the way the platform is administered.
• Provide on-call support for ServiceNow

 • Bachelor’s degree in the field of computer science, information systems, other related degree, or experience equivalent
• 5 years of ServiceNow platform experience including a mix of development and administration
• Familiar with HTML, JavaScript, CSS etc.

• Knowledge of Agile framework and experience in measuring level of effort with enhancements, defects, and stories
• Experience with Core, Knowledge Management, Change Management, Incident, Problem, Hardware and Software Asset Management modules
• Experience building automation workflows and ability to code review simple workflows (e.g., those built using Catalog Builder)
• Experience building business rules, client scripts, and notifications

• Productive attitude with the focus on progressing the business forward

Role Overview

As a ServiceNow Developer (Band: TE3) , you will be responsible for designing, developing, and configuring core ServiceNow modules and custom applications. Your primary focus will be on driving efficiency across enterprise service pillars—including HR, Legal, Facilities, and Procurement—while maintaining the integrity of the Configuration Management Database (CMDB), handling complex integrations, and automating quality assurance via automated testing frameworks.

Core Responsibilities

Primary Focus Areas (Core Development & Architecture)

 • IT Service Management (ITSM): Design, develop, and maintain core ITSM modules to optimize IT service delivery and operational workflows.
• HR Service Delivery (HRSD): Configure and customize HR workflows, lifecycle events, and case management to streamline HR operations.
• Legal & Facilities Service Management: Architect and support tailored workflows for Legal and Facilities teams to automate request fulfillment and case tracking.
• Procurement Service Management: Build and manage procurement workflows, asset tracking, and vendor request systems.
• Configuration Management Database (CMDB): Own the health, architecture, and configuration of the CMDB, ensuring accurate data mapping and asset relationship management.
• Integrations: Build, maintain, and troubleshoot robust integrations across key enterprise platforms, including Active Directory (AD), Workday, Okta, and various custom third-party APIs.

Secondary Focus Areas (Portal, Analytics & Custom Apps)

 • Employee Service Centre (ESC) Portal: Enhance user experience by configuring the ESC portal, content delivery, and service catalogs.
• Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM): Support SPM modules to align business strategy with project execution and resource management.
• Custom Application Development: Scope, design, and deploy bespoke applications on the ServiceNow platform to solve unique business challenges.
• Reports & Dashboards: Create and maintain insightful analytics, performance analytics indicators, and visual dashboards for stakeholders.

Quality Assurance & Testing (Tertiary)

 • QA-ATF (Automated Test Framework): Implement and run Automated Test Framework (ATF) suites to ensure platform stability, minimize regression risks during upgrades, and streamline deployments.

 Qualifications & Skills

 Experience & Level

 • Job Band: TE3 (Mid-to-Senior level developer indicating independent execution capability and technical ownership).
• Technical Breadth: Strong hands-on experience across multiple ServiceNow suites (ITSM, HRSD, Enterprise Service Management).

 The Future Begins Here:

 At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future-ready capabilities, we are meeting the needs of patients, our people, and the planet.

Bangalore, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.

 At Takeda’s ICC we Unite in Diversity :

 Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and the abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators’ journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team.

 The Opportunity:

 As a ServiceNow Software Engineer, you will lead, design, develop, configure, and customize (when necessary) ServiceNow applications and services. You will deliver new functionality across applications, support the entire development lifecycle and assist the platform support with product related incident resolution.

This role positions you as a ServiceNow Subject Matter Expert, steering the creation and implementation of automation solutions to optimize Takeda’s IT Service Management processes. With specific emphasis on the ServiceNow SecOps and GRC modules: , you will ensure seamless functionality, enhanced operational efficiency, and a user-friendly experience. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality Service Catalog items and workflows within Takeda’s ServiceNow platform, leveraging your technical expertise in ServiceNow development practices and a deep understanding of IT Service Management and business process automation.

 Key Responsibilities:

 • Develop and customize Service Catalog items, workflows, and integrations using Generic Workflow, Flow Designer, scripting, and APIs.
• Design and implement scalable solutions focused on the ServiceNow Service Catalog module.
• Develop Service Catalog items, workflows, and customizations using Generic Workflow, Flow Designer, scripting, APIs, etc.
• Collaborate with Business Analysts, Product Owners, and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
• Enhance user experience and implement automation to optimize service delivery.
• Maintain and update Service Catalog offerings to ensure scalability and usability.
• Build and support integrations between ServiceNow and third-party systems to enhance workflow automation.
• Document all configurations, workflows, and processes to ensure clear communication and future scalability.
• Present product demos and technical showcases for stakeholders.
• Collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver tailored solutions.
• Adherence to ServiceNow best practices, Takeda-defined standards, and Agile development schedules.
• Leverage Takeda’s SDLC toolset for efficient development and deployment.
• Drive innovation and optimize Service Catalog functionality to meet evolving business needs.
• Stay updated on ServiceNow advancements, incorporating new features into solutions.

 Skills and Qualifications:

 • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science/Information technology; or relevant work experience.
• 3+ years of experience in architecting, designing and developing ServiceNow solutions (especially, Integrated Risk Management and SecOps: modules).
• 2+ experience with ServiceNow Service Catalog module is a must.
• Strong understanding of Governance, Risk, and Compliance and Security Operations: processes.
• Strong expertise with ServiceNow platform development, especially Service Catalog, Flow Designer, and scripting languages.
• Proficient in creating Server-side and Client-side scripts, Business Rules, UI Policies, UI Actions, and ACLs.
• Excellent communication skills with ability to communicate complex technical concepts and align organization on decisions.
• ServiceNow System Administrator certification (required).
• ServiceNow Application Developer certification (preferred).
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to manage priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
• Fluent English (both written and oral).

 What Takeda Can Offer You:

 • Takeda is certified as a Top Employer, not only in India, but also globally. No investment we make pays greater dividends than taking good care of our people.
• At Takeda, you take the lead on building and shaping your own career.
• Joining the ICC in Bangalore will give you access to high-end technology, continuous training and a diverse and inclusive network of colleagues who will support your career growth.

 Benefits:

Competitive Salary + Performance Annual Bonus

 Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 56,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion (at the go-forward perimeter), operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is the brand under which Atos SE (Societas Europaea) operates. Atos SE listed on Euronext Paris.

The purpose of Atos Group is to help design the future of the information space. Its expertise and services support the development of knowledge, education and research in a multicultural approach and contribute to the development of scientific and technological excellence. Across the world, the Group enables its customers and employees, and members of societies at large to live, work and develop sustainably, in a safe and secure information space.

 Job Title ServiceNow Business Analyst 

 Location Mumbai / Chennai / Bangalore

 Experience 8+ Years 

 Key Responsibilities

 • Perform Business Analysis for ServiceNow ITSM modules (INC, PRB, CHG, REQ, KNW, SLM)
• Handle tickets, defects, service requests, enhancements and BAU support
• Gather, analyze and document requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
• Configure and manage SLA/OLA definitions, schedules, workflows, and conditions
• Monitor SLA performance, breach tracking, compliance reporting and audits
• Perform incident trend analysis, problem RCA and change impact analysis
• Support UAT, defect tracking, release validation and production support
• Work on ServiceNow workflows, forms and functional configurations Develop Power BI dashboards for ITSM, SLA performance and operational KPIs
• Support data integration and reporting using Microsoft Fabric (basic architecture understanding) 

 Required Skills

 • Strong expertise in ServiceNow ITSM & SLM (SLA configuration, tracking, reporting)
• Experience in ticket handling, ITSM operations and SLA management
• Business Analysis (requirement gathering, user stories, Agile)
• Power BI (DAX, data modeling, dashboard development) SQL and data analysis
• Basic understanding of Microsoft Fabric / data architecture
• Knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices Mumbai, India Offshore

 Our Offering 

 • Global cutting-edge IT projects that shape the future of digital and have a positive impact on environment.
• Wellbeing programs & work-life balance - integration and passion sharing events.
• Attractive Salary and Company Initiative Benefits

ServiceNow Developer IRM / BCM / SecOps

 Experience: 6–12 Years

 Location: Hyderabad

 Employment Type: Full-Time

 Role Summary

 We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Developer with strong expertise in IRM, BCM, SecOps, Operational Resilience, Privacy Management, and Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) to develop, customize, and support enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions.

The ideal candidate should possess strong hands-on ServiceNow development experience across governance, risk, compliance, resilience, and security domains. The role requires building scalable workflows, integrations, automation capabilities, and operational dashboards aligned with enterprise governance and cyber-security objectives.

 Key Responsibilities ServiceNow Development 

 • Design, develop, configure, and customize ServiceNow applications and workflows across IRM, BCM, SecOps, and Operational Resilience modules.
• Develop solutions using:
 • JavaScript
• Glide API
• Script Includes
• Business Rules
• Client Scripts
• UI Policies
• Flow Designer
• IntegrationHub

• Build reusable and scalable components following ServiceNow best practices.

 IRM / GRC Development 

 • Configure and implement ServiceNow IRM capabilities including:
 • Risk Management
• Policy & Compliance
• Audit Management
• Regulatory Change Management (RCM)

• Develop workflows for:
 • Risk assessments
• Controls management
• Compliance monitoring
• Issue remediation
• Attestation processes

• Support enterprise governance and compliance automation initiatives.

 Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)

 • Configure and enhance TPRM workflows for vendor lifecycle management and risk evaluation.
• Implement vendor onboarding/offboarding workflows using structured questionnaires and assessment processes.
• Support automation of vendor risk scoring, due diligence tracking, and ongoing compliance monitoring.
• Integrate external vendor risk and security compliance signals into ServiceNow workflows.
• Support reporting and dashboarding for third-party risk visibility.

 Business Continuity Management (BCM) 

 • Develop and support BCM capabilities including:
 • Business Impact Analysis (BIA)
• Disaster Recovery planning
• Crisis management workflows
• Recovery procedures

• Configure continuity plans, recovery objectives, testing schedules, and resilience workflows.
• Support operational resilience and continuity readiness initiatives through workflow automation.

 Regulatory Change Management (RCM)

 • Configure workflows and automation for monitoring and managing regulatory and legislative changes.
• Support ingestion and mapping of regulatory updates to controls, policies, and compliance requirements.
• Automate impact assessment workflows and remediation tracking for regulatory changes.
• Enable traceability between regulations, controls, risks, and business processes.

 Operational Resilience Management 

 • Develop workflows supporting enterprise operational resilience initiatives.
• Configure tracking and monitoring for resilience pillars across:
 • People
• Processes
• Technology
• Facilities

• Support operational health monitoring, resilience dashboards, and disruption management workflows.
• Enable visibility into business service dependencies and resilience metrics.

 Privacy Management

 • Configure and enhance ServiceNow Privacy Management workflows and risk assessments.
• Support privacy impact assessments (PIA) and personal data risk management processes.
• Integrate privacy risks and controls into the enterprise risk management framework.
• Develop workflows supporting data protection, compliance, and remediation activities.

 Continuous Authorization & Monitoring (CAM) 

 • Implement and support CAM workflows for regulated and compliance-focused environments.
• Develop risk management workflows aligned to frameworks such as:
 • RMF
• FedRAMP
• Continuous compliance monitoring

• Support automated control validation, evidence collection, and ongoing compliance assessments.
• Configure integrations and monitoring workflows for compliance tracking and audit readiness.

 Security Operations (SecOps) 

 • Develop and support ServiceNow SecOps solutions including:
 • Security Incident Response (SIR)
• Vulnerability Response
• Threat Intelligence integrations

• Configure workflows for incident triage, remediation, escalation, and vulnerability management.
• Integrate ServiceNow with SIEM, monitoring, vulnerability scanning, and security platforms.
• Support automation of security processes and operational response workflows.

 Integrations & Automation

 • Build REST/SOAP integrations with enterprise applications, governance systems, and security platforms.
• Configure IntegrationHub and MID Server integrations.
• Develop automated workflows and orchestration capabilities using Flow Designer.
• Support enterprise data synchronization and workflow automation initiatives.

 Platform Support & Governance

 • Participate in code reviews and follow ServiceNow development standards and governance.
• Troubleshoot and resolve platform and application issues.
• Support upgrades, patches, releases, and deployment activities.
• Prepare technical documentation and support QA/testing activities.
• Collaborate with architects, administrators, business users, and security teams during implementation and support phases.

 Required Skills & Experience 

 • 6–12 years of overall IT experience with strong ServiceNow development expertise.
• Hands-on experience in:
 • IRM / GRC
• BCM
• SecOps
• TPRM
• Operational Resilience
• Privacy Management
• Regulatory Change Management

• Strong expertise in:
 • JavaScript
• Glide API
• Flow Designer
• IntegrationHub
• ServiceNow scripting

• Experience with:
 • Security Incident Response
• Vulnerability Response
• Risk and compliance workflows
• Business continuity and resilience processes

• Experience developing REST/SOAP integrations and MID Server configurations.
• Good understanding of CMDB and enterprise integration architecture.
• Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
• Good communication and stakeholder interaction skills.

 Preferred Skills

 • Exposure to CAM, RMF, FedRAMP, or regulated compliance environments.
• Experience integrating ServiceNow with SIEM, vulnerability management, and cloud security platforms.
• Knowledge of operational resilience and enterprise governance frameworks.
• Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and ITIL processes.
• Exposure to cloud environments and enterprise cyber-security operations.

 Preferred Certifications

 • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
• Certified Application Developer (CAD)
• CIS – Risk & Compliance (preferred)

Successfully plan, execute, monitor, control, and close all technical tasks related to configuration and implementation of all aspects of the ServiceNow platform.

• Create/configure and write advanced scripting in Business Rules, Script Includes, REST API, UI Policies, Client Scripts, ACL’s, Notifications, UI Pages, UI Macros, and SLAs/OLAs.
• Integrations knowledge using REST, SOAP
• Hands-on Experience on Service Portal
• Hands-on Experience on Performance Analytics
• Have knowledge on workflow build or modify workflows and/or Flow Designer based on the requirements
• Provide technical support assistance to diagnose and resolve issues and troubleshoot complex ‘how to’ questions.
• Define complex application development administration and programming standards.
• Works collaboratively with peers to coordinate the overall delivery of technology solutions to the business groups.
• Support and create any necessary project documentation that relates to evidencing our requirements. Documenting our processes and procedures and supporting the creation of solution and operations documents.
• Experience in implementation of ServiceNow HAMPro, SAMPro, Discovery, Integration Hub is an added advantage
• 2 to 4 years of experience as ServiceNow Developer (implementation role).
• Good knowledge of ServiceNow and ITIL.
• Understanding Scrum Methodology.
• Strong engagement, communication and facilitation skills.
• ServiceNow Certified System Administration

Summary

 Position Summary 

 Enterprise Performance 

 Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions

 Position Summary

 ServiceNow - Technical-Architect 

 The ServiceNow Architect is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing ServiceNow solutions to meet business requirements. With over 11 years of experience, the architect will lead technical strategy, provide guidance to development teams, and ensure best practices are followed across ServiceNow implementations

 Work You’ll Do 

 Practitioners with a passion for helping clients solve complex Finance, Supply Chain, and IT challenges will be brought together under one group. This enables professionals to interact with and learn from their colleagues who understand the specific challenges that exist in each domain.Practitioners can further their skill development and grow their careers while working across the Advise, Implement, and Operate spectrum.

 The Team 

 TSO Offering enables our clients to achieve their objectives of Digital transformation of enterprise services and IT transformation across enterprise functions through our advice & implement services. USI team with its technology and process skills expertise, experience & scale is an integral part of offering . USI team works through the lifecycle of these transformation programs.

 Qualifications required: 

 Must have skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 

 • 11+ years of IT experience, with at least 6 years in ServiceNow architecture and development. 
• Deep expertise in multiple ServiceNow modules (e.g., ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM). 
• Strong experience with ServiceNow scripting (JavaScript, Glide API), Flow Designer, and Service Portal. 
• Proven track record in designing integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, web services, and third-party tools. 
• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications required; Certified Application Developer (CAD) and Certified Technical Architect (CTA) preferred. 
• Design and architect ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, or other ServiceNow modules based on business needs. 
• Lead and mentor ServiceNow developers and administrators; review code and solution designs. 
• Architect integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems using APIs, MID Servers, and integration tools. 
• Plan and manage ServiceNow upgrades, performance tuning, and platform optimization. 
• Create and maintain architecture diagrams, technical documentation, and solution design documents. Ensure solutions adhere to security, compliance, and data privacy requirements. 

 Good to have skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 

 • Oversee custom application development, scripting (client/server), and workflow automation within ServiceNow. 
• Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable ServiceNow solutions. 

 Education 

 • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

 Locations 

 • Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Pune

Genesys empowers organizations of all sizes to improve loyalty and business outcomes by creating the best experiences for their customers and employees. Through Genesys Cloud, the AI-powered Experience Orchestration platform, organizations can accelerate growth by delivering empathetic, personalized experiences at scale to drive customer loyalty, workforce engagement, efficiency and operational improvements.

We employ more than 6,000 people across the globe who embrace empathy and cultivate collaboration to succeed. And, while we offer great benefits and perks like larger tech companies, our employees have the independence to make a larger impact on the company and take ownership of their work. Join the team and create the future of customer experience together.

 Summary

 Own and govern the ServiceNow CMDB to ensure it is a trusted system of record supporting ITSM and ITOM.

Drive data quality, CI lifecycle management, and integration with discovery and automation capabilities.

Enable accurate impact analysis and operational decision-making.

 Key Responsibilities

 • Define and govern CMDB strategy, standards, and processes (ITIL 4, CSDM)
• Manage CI lifecycle and maintain accurate relationships across infrastructure, applications, and cloud
• Drive data quality via audits, reconciliation, and KPI tracking
• Integrate CMDB with Discovery, Service Mapping, and external data sources
• Support Incident, Problem, and Change with impact analysis and root cause insights
• Partner with stakeholders to ensure adoption, accountability, and continuous improvement
• Identify and implement automation opportunities

 Required Qualifications

 • Hands-on ServiceNow CMDB experience
• Strong ITSM knowledge (Incident, Problem, Change)
• CI lifecycle and relationship modeling experience
• Discovery and data reconciliation knowledge
• Data governance and quality management experience

 Preferred Qualifications

 • Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
• ServiceNow ITOM (Discovery, Service Mapping)
• Scripting (PowerShell, Python)
• CSDM familiarity
• ServiceNow Data Foundations Certification

 Nice to Have

 • Knowledge Management exposure

 Core Competencies

 • Data-driven, process-oriented mindset
• Ability to influence cross-functional teams
• Clear communicator (technical and business)
• Focus on scalability and standardization

Working hours-2:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST

 Position Summary 

 L50 – ServiceNow Engineering Manager, Product & Engineering 

 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced ServiceNow Engineering Manager to join our team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with ServiceNow's Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM), Application Portfolio Management (APM), IRM (Integrated Risk Management) and Hardware Asset Management (HAM) modules. This role involves designing, implementing, and optimizing ServiceNow solutions to meet our organization's business needs and drive operational efficiency

 Key Responsibilities include: 

 Technical Excellence: 

 • Technical Direction: Provide technical direction and oversight for software development projects, ensuring adherence to best practices and coding standards. 
• Code Review: Review and approve code, and technical documentation and ensure team adheres to ServiceNow best practices. 

 Implementation and Configuration :

 • Oversee the implementation and configuration of ServiceNow modules, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems. 
• Customize ServiceNow applications to meet specific business requirements. 
• Manage and execute ServiceNow upgrades and patching. 
• Implement and optimize SPM processes, including demand management, project and portfolio management, and resource management. 
• Implement and manage APM processes to assess and optimize the application landscape. 
• Develop dashboards and reports to provide visibility into project and portfolio performance. 
• Implement and manage HAM processes to track and manage hardware assets throughout their lifecycle. 
• Ensure accurate and up-to-date asset records and compliance with asset management policies. 

 Collaboration and Stakeholder Management :

 • Collaborate with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external vendors to gather requirements and deliver effective solutions. 
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members. 

 Leadership and Management: 

 • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and manage a team of software engineers, providing guidance and support to ensure high performance. 
• Performance Management: Conduct regular performance reviews, set goals, and create development plans for team members. 
• Team Environment: Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment that encourages innovation and continuous improvement. 

 Continuous Improvement :

 • Identify opportunities for process improvements and automation within the ServiceNow platform. 
• Stay updated with the latest ServiceNow features, releases, and industry trends. 
• Drive innovation and best practices in ServiceNow implementations 

 Education Qualification and Experience Required: 

 • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
• Overall 10+yrs of experience in technical development role with minimum of 5 years of experience working with ServiceNow, including hands-on experience with SPM, APM, and HAM modules. 
• Proven track record of designing and implementing ServiceNow solutions in a complex enterprise environment. 

 Technical Skills 

 • Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and other web technologies. 

 Soft Skills 

 • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
• Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities. 
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
• Strong project management and organizational skills 

 Location : Hyderabad

 Shift timing – 11AM to 8PM

 How You Will Grow

 At Deloitte, we have invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. About Accenture:

 Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world’s largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 750K people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com

 About Global Network:

 Accenture Strategy shapes our clients’ future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, every business is a digital business. Digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers, and communities how they manufacture and deliver products and services, and how they run their organizations. This is our unique differentiator. We seek people who recognize and understand the impact that digital, and technology have on every industry and every sector, and share our passion to shape unique strategies that allow our clients to succeed in this environment.

To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy's services include those provided by our Global Network – a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Approximately 10,000 consultants are part of this rapidly expanding network, providing specialized and strategic industry and functional consulting expertise from key locations around the world. Our Global Network teams complement our in-country teams to deliver cutting-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. For more information visit www.accenture.com/capabilitynetwork.

 Why Technology Consulting

 The Technology Consulting business within Global Network invents the future for clients by providing them with the right guidance, design thinking and innovative solutions for technological transformation.

As technology rapidly evolves, it’s more important than ever to have an innovation advisor who can create a new vision or put one into place to solve the client’s toughest business problems.

Specialize in management or technology consulting to transform the world's leading organizations by building innovative business solutions as their trusted advisor by:

 Helping Clients : Rethinking IT and Digital ecosystems and innovating to help clients keep pace with fast-changing, customer-driven environments.

 Enhancing your Skillset: Building expertise and innovating with leading-edge technologies such as Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence and Cloud.

 Transforming Businesses : Developing customized, next-generation products and services that help clients shift to new business models designed for today's connected landscape of disruptive technologies

 Principal Duties 

 And Responsibilities:

 Working closely with our clients, Consulting professionals design, build and implement ServiceNow and ITSM transformation strategies that enhance service delivery, operational resilience, and enterprise performance. They develop specialized expertise - process, platform, industry, and architectural in a dynamic project environment that offers multiple opportunities for career growth.

The opportunities to make a difference within large-scale service transformation initiatives are limitless in today’s digital enterprise landscape. Here are just a few of your day-to-day responsibilities:

 • Lead large-scale ServiceNow and ITSM transformation programs across multiple business units
• ITSM processes Transformation/Modernization using Agentic AI/Gen AI
• Design enterprise ITSM strategy and ServiceNow roadmap aligned to business and digital objectives
• Conduct current-state assessments and define future-state service management operating models
• Architect scalable ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, ITOM, SPM, HRSD, and GRC modules or any other ServiceNow modules
• Drive CMDB strategy, service mapping, automation, and platform governance frameworks
• Translate complex business requirements into functional designs and implementation blueprints
• Implement programs/interventions that prepare the organization for new service management processes
• Identify, assess, and solve complex IT service management challenges requiring structured evaluation
• Oversee end-to-end implementation including configuration, integrations, data migration, and hypercare
• Provide thought leadership in ITSM best practices, ITIL alignment, and platform optimization
• Drive enterprise service architecture, integration architecture, and process standardization
• Help clients transition from fragmented service processes to an integrated, automation-first platform
• Manage multi-disciplinary teams to shape, sell, communicate, and deliver ServiceNow engagements
• Participate in client proposals, presentations, and solution defense discussions
• Effectively communicate target-state service architecture and transformation journey to executive stakeholders
• Cloud Architecture with private, public and hybrid cloud architectures, pros/cons, and Hybrid cloud integration architecture for clients

 Qualifications:

 • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
• MBA from a Tier-1 institute (preferred)
• 12+ years of consulting experience and/or working with large enterprises leading ServiceNow and ITSM transformation programs
• Strong experience in ITSM strategy, process assessment, service operating model design, and enterprise platform implementation
• Proven experience across ServiceNow modules such as ITSM, ITOM, SPM, HRSD, and GRC/IRM
• ServiceNow certifications such as CIS (ITSM/ITOM/SPM/HRSD/GRC) preferred
• ITIL certification (v3/v4) strongly preferred
• Cloud Architecture certification (Azure or GCP or AWS)

 Experience:

 • We are seeking experienced professionals who have led large-scale ServiceNow and ITSM transformation engagements across enterprise environments. The ideal candidates will have deep expertise in ITSM strategy, service operating model design, platform architecture, and multi-module ServiceNow implementations (ITSM, ITOM, SPM, HRSD, GRC), with hands-on experience across the full lifecycle—from assessment and solution design to implementation and optimization—focused on driving measurable service excellence and digital transformation outcomes
• The candidate should have practical industry expertise in one of these areas - Financial Services, Retail, consumer goods, Telecommunications, Life Sciences, Transportation, Hospitality, Automotive/Industrial, Mining and Resources.

 Key Competencies and Skills:

 The right candidate should have competency and skills aligned to one or more of these archetypes –

 • ITSM & Enterprise Service Transformation – Experience leading enterprise-wide ITSM transformations, designing target service operating models, process standardization, and automation-first service architectures aligned to ITIL best practices. Exposure to Agentic AI/Gen AI for Processes modernization
• ServiceNow Platform Architecture – Experience designing scalable ServiceNow architecture across ITSM, ITOM, SPM, HRSD, and GRC/IRM modules, including CMDB strategy, service mapping, governance models, and platform upgrade strategy.
• ServiceNow Solution Design & Integration – Expertise in translating business requirements into functional and technical designs, including integrations (API, IntegrationHub, MID Server), data models, workflow orchestration, and enterprise toolchain integration.
• CMDB & ITOM Strategy – Delivering CMDB maturity roadmaps, discovery strategy, data governance frameworks, and event management integration to enable operational visibility and reliability.
• Implementation & Program Leadership – Driving large-scale ServiceNow implementations from roadmap definition to deployment and hypercare, managing cross-functional teams and multi-region rollouts.
• Service Automation & Digital Workflow Enablement – Designing automated service experiences leveraging Flow Designer, catalog orchestration, AI/Virtual Agent capabilities, and performance analytics.

 Secondary Skills (Preferred)

 • Application Modernization – Experience leading and designing the composable architecture leveraging Microservices, EDA on the Cloud Platforms.
• Cloud Architecture: Experience with private, public and hybrid cloud architectures, pros/cons, and Hybrid cloud integration architecture
• Cloud-native application development, DevOps and data integration within cloud platform
• Cloud Migration: Delivering cloud migration roadmaps and managing execution from a project management perspective.
• Cloud Deployment across various hyper-scaler platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and models (PaaS, SaaS, IaaS), containers and virtualization platforms (VMWare.)
• AIOps & Intelligent Operations – Exposure to AIOps concepts including event correlation, noise reduction, predictive analytics, and automation-driven incident management within IT operations environments.
• IT Infrastructure Architecture – Working knowledge of enterprise infrastructure components including networks, servers, virtualization, containers, middleware, and security layers to ensure accurate CMDB modeling and service dependency mapping.

 Other Desired Skills -

 • Strong desire to work in technology-driven business transformation
• Strong knowledge of technology trends across IT and digital and how they can be applied to companies to address real world problems and opportunities.
• Comfort conveying both high-level and detailed information, adjusting the way ideas are presented to better address varying social styles and audiences.
• Leading proof of concept and/or pilot implementations and defining the plan to scale implementations across multiple technology domains
• Flexibility to accommodate client travel requirements
• Published Thought leadership Whitepapers, POV’s

 SUMMARY:
 The ServiceNow Technical Architect will lead solution architecture, technical design, implementation governance, and complex platform delivery across the Now Platform. The role requires strong hands-on architecture capability across core platform development, integrations, security, data model design, scalable implementation patterns, and deep portal engineering experience across Employee Center and Customer Service Management portals, with a preference for candidates who hold ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or Certified Master Architect (CMA) credentials.

 WHAT YOU WILL DO:

 Own end-to-end technical architecture for ServiceNow programs, including solution design, integration patterns, environment strategy, data architecture, security model, portal architecture, and deployment governance.

Translate business and operating model requirements into scalable ServiceNow technical solutions across one or more product lines such as ITSM, ITOM, CSM, HRSD, SPM, IRM, or custom applications.

Define and enforce platform standards for scripting, scoped app design, CMDB and data model integrity, API integrations, DevOps and CI/CD alignment, portal design patterns, and upgrade-safe extensibility.

Provide hands-on technical leadership for complex builds, including Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Script Includes, business rules, workspace and portal components, search experiences, and external system integrations.

Lead technical design workshops, architecture reviews, proof-of-concepts, and design authority forums with stakeholders, delivery teams, and customer leadership.

Mentor developers, leads, and consultants on architecture patterns, engineering quality, portal design strategy, performance optimization, and secure development best practices.

Identify risks, technical debt, and non-scalable customizations early, and steer delivery toward maintainable out-of-box aligned architecture decisions.

 Core Technical Skills
 Deep expertise in Now Platform architecture, data model design, ACL and security architecture, domain separation considerations, update strategy, and integration design.

Strong hands-on capability in JavaScript and ServiceNow server-side and client-side scripting, with working knowledge of HTML, CSS, REST, SOAP, and API-led integrations.

Experience designing and governing enterprise integrations with cloud platforms, identity providers, observability tools, middleware, and line-of-business applications.

Strong understanding of SaaS and PaaS architecture principles, multi-tenancy, automation, analytics, AI-adjacent platform capabilities, and enterprise architecture frameworks.

Experience across multiple ServiceNow product lines beyond core ITSM, preferably including at least two or more of ITOM, CSM, HRSD, ITAM, SPM, IRM/GRC, or App Engine.

Ability to balance out-of-box capability, configuration, and custom development while preserving upgradeability and long-term platform health.

 Employee Center and CSM portal expertise -
 In-depth knowledge of building and governing Employee Center experiences, including Unified Taxonomy, Curated Experiences, Dynamic Topic Pages, Mega Menu, My Active Items, Recommended for You, Popular Topics, Quick Links, and employee-centric search configuration.

In-depth knowledge of building and governing CSM portals using Service Portal and Configurable Portal widgets, including page creation, widget configuration, Portal Data List, case-centric navigation, knowledge exposure, request experiences, and portal-specific access models.

Ability to design when to use separate portals versus a unified experience, with clear understanding that Employee Center and Customer Service portals are separate portals with distinct URLs, access controls, and licensing implications.

Strong experience in widget strategy, including using base widgets as-is, cloning widgets for controlled enhancement, and developing custom widgets only where required by experience, governance, or business differentiation.

Expertise in building portal information architecture, including taxonomy-led multi-department navigation for Employee Center and siloed case-management journeys for CSM portals.

Working knowledge of portal search configuration, knowledge surfacing, user criteria, content targeting, and performance considerations for high-traffic self-service experiences.

Ability to define migration and coexistence strategies between legacy Service Portal implementations and Employee Center experiences, including widget reuse, cloning strategy, and content/taxonomy redesign.

 Portal-specific Responsibilities -
 Architect employee self-service experiences that support multi-department discovery through taxonomy, dynamic pages, targeted content, and consolidated task visibility.

Architect customer and partner self-service portals that prioritize case creation, case tracking, knowledge deflection, contextual lists, and configurable portal widgets.

Establish standards for portal page models, widget reuse, naming conventions, content governance, search tuning, analytics, and extensibility.

Guide teams on trade-offs between out-of-box Employee Center capabilities and custom Service Portal development for CSM or specialized service experiences

 QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:

 9+ years of ServiceNow implementation, development, or architecture experience, including ownership of complex technical solution design and delivery.

Proven experience acting as a technical lead, solution architect, or platform architect on enterprise-scale ServiceNow programs.

Demonstrated success in designing complex solutions, custom applications, integrations, and self-service portal experiences across multiple systems and stakeholder groups.

Hands-on experience with Employee Center and or CSM portal design, including portal information architecture, widgets, search, security, and content strategy.

Strong client-facing consulting experience, including workshops, stakeholder communication, architecture presentations, and technical governance.

 Leadership & behavioral traits
 Strong problem-solving ability with the judgment to simplify complex requirements into practical architecture decisions.

Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs to senior stakeholders.

Collaborative leadership style with the ability to mentor teams, influence design choices, and uphold engineering and portal standards across delivery streams.

High accountability, delivery discipline, and comfort operating in ambiguous enterprise transformation environments.

 CERTIFICATIONS:

 Preferred
 ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA).

ServiceNow Certified Master Architect (CMA).

 Strongly desired
 Certified System Administrator (CSA).

Certified Application Developer (CAD).

Two or more Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications aligned to major product lines such as CSM, HRSD, or ITSM.

Architecture Excellence accreditation, where relevant to current CTA pathway requirements.

job_title: Service Now Platform Data Security Engineering- Manager
job_description:
Location: Hyderabad
 Timings: 2 PM till 10:30 PM(IST)
 Working Model: Hybrid
 

 Key Responsibilities 
 · Security Strategy & Compliance 
 • Develop and enforce security policies, standards, and best practices for the ServiceNow platform.
• Ensure compliance with industry regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2) and internal security policies.
• Establish governance frameworks for secure development, data protection, and risk mitigation.

 

 Access Control & Identity Management 
 • Design and manage role-based access control (RBAC), ACLs, and authentication mechanisms in ServiceNow.
• Implement Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and identity federation with enterprise IAM solutions.
• Regularly audit and refine user roles to enforce least privilege access principles.

 

 Security Operations & Incident Management 
 • Oversee the implementation and optimization of ServiceNow Security Operations (SecOps), including:
• Security Incident Response (SIR) – streamline incident detection, triage, and resolution.
• Vulnerability Response (VR) – automate vulnerability identification and remediation workflows.
• Threat Intelligence – integrate threat feeds and security insights for proactive defense.
• Coordinate with cybersecurity teams to detect, investigate, and respond to threats affecting ServiceNow.

 

 Data Security & Encryption 
 • Implement data encryption, tokenization, and masking strategies to protect sensitive information.
• Define and enforce data retention, auditing, and logging policies for compliance and monitoring.
• Monitor access patterns and system activity to identify potential security threats.

 

 Secure Integrations & Automation 
 • Design and enforce secure API management for integrations between ServiceNow and third-party security tools (e.g., SIEM, EDR, IAM).
• Leverage IntegrationHub, Automation Engine, and Orchestration to streamline security workflows.
• Ensure secure data exchange and prevent unauthorized access to ServiceNow instances.

 

 Risk & Compliance Management 
 • Deploy and manage ServiceNow Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) solutions to assess security risks.
• Conduct regular security audits, risk assessments, and penetration tests on the ServiceNow platform.
• Define and implement security controls to mitigate risks and enhance compliance.

 

 Required Skills & Qualifications: 
 Technical Expertise: 
 • ServiceNow Security: Deep understanding of SecOps, GRC, RBAC, ACLs, and platform security best practices.
• Cybersecurity & Compliance: Strong knowledge of security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS), regulatory compliance, and risk management.
• Access & Identity Management: Expertise in SSO, MFA, OAuth, LDAP, and user authentication.
• Integration & Development: Experience with REST APIs, JavaScript, OAuth, and secure integration practices.
• Cloud Security: Understanding of SaaS security, encryption methods, and cloud-based security models.

 

 Certifications 
 • ServiceNow Certifications:
• Certified System Administrator (CSA)
• Certified Implementation Specialist – SecOps or GRC

 

 Preferred Qualifications: 
 • Experience securing large-scale ServiceNow implementations in regulated industries (finance, healthcare, government).
• Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills to interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Knowledge of emerging security trends, zero trust architecture, and AI-driven security solutions.
• Cybersecurity Certifications:
• Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
• Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)

 

 Experience Required: 
 • 15+ years of IT security experience, with 12+ years in ServiceNow security architecture, administration, or operations.
• Hands-on experience in security automation, incident response, and risk management using ServiceNow.
• Prior experience working with cybersecurity, risk management, and IT governance teams.

• Coach, share best practices, and enable internal sales teams with foundational specialty solution area knowledge.

 To be successful in this role you have:

• 7+ years of proven success in direct field sales, focusing on acquiring new enterprise clients in Security and Identity domains. 
• Demonstrated history of delivering results above plan, with consistent quota attainment and a record of driving sustained business growth. 
• Recent success closing significant sized deals in Identity & Access Management (IGA/PAM), SecOps, Data Security, Cloud Security, or Application Security. 
• Broad security domain expertise, with experience selling across identity, data security, cloud security, sec ops, or compliance. 
• Strong executive presence and polish, with excellent listening and presentation skills.

job_description:
About Us

 Join us at Orange Business!

We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.

Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.

 About The Role

 We are seeking a highly skilled Lead Designer with knowledge of telecom domain and proficiency in ServiceNow. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of ServiceNow platform capabilities, business processes, and telecom services. As a Lead Designer, you will play a pivotal role in driving the design, implementation, and optimization of ServiceNow solutions to support our telecom service offerings.

The mission of Lead Designer is to:

 • Requirement Elicitation and Analysis:
• Collaborate with Customers & internal stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements
• Elicit, document, and analyze business requirements, processes, and workflows.
• Translate business requirements into clear and concise functional specifications for technical teams.
• ServiceNow Configuration and Customization:
• Utilize your knowledge in ServiceNow specially focusing on NowAssist module to suggest configuration and customization of the platform to meet the business requirements.
• Coordinate with Business stakeholders and ServiceNow dev team to deliver solutions for incident management, change management, service request fulfillment, and other IT service management processes.
• Co-manage the backlog with the Product Owner
• Breakown epic into detailed features and user stories
• Document and prioritize backlog
• Solution Design:
• Collaborate with System Architect to design solutions that meet business needs.
• Propose innovative and practical solutions to address business challenges.
• Ensure that proposed solutions align with the organization's strategic goals and technological capabilities.
• Stakeholder Communication:
• Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, providing regular updates on project status, risks, and issues.
• Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment between business requirements and ServiceNow solutions.
• Communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• Present findings, recommendations, and project updates to various audiences.
• Documentation:
• Create detailed documentation including business requirements, process flows, use cases, and user stories.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date project documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
• Testing:
• Participate in system testing, user acceptance testing, and validation of implemented solutions.
• Ensure that delivered solutions meet the specified requirements and are of high quality.
• Process Improvement & Support:
• Identify areas for process optimization and efficiency enhancement.
• Recommend process improvements and assist in their implementation.
• Support Business on bug and anomalies fixing

 About You

 9+ years experience in business analysis with minimum 2 years experience in ServiceNow implementation specially focusing on customer migration with NowAssist module. Good level of practiced technical knowledge. Agile methodology or SAFe is must (Scrum implementation)

Completion of at least one of the following:

 • Certified System Administrator,
• Certified Implementation Specialist – CSM,
• Certified Implementation Specialist - Software Asset Management

The main responsibilities related to the Lead Designer are:

 • NowAssist use cases to be created & implement based on business interaction.
• Implementation of Agentic AI & Gen AI capabilities based on best practices of NowAssist.
• Ability to work with aggressive schedules.
• Ability to lead end to end delivery.
• Follow Agile processes, groom user stories along with business & IT teams.
• Prepare functional specification documentation
• Support all analysis and design activities, and closely work with other teams involved in the project, including development team, testing team and business users
• Prioritize requirements based on relative business importance
• Work with developments teams
• Perform functional testing
• Support regression and integration testing
• Take requirement related decisions
• Groom the Product Backlog as and when needed.
• Prepare users stories, which have details of technical (non-functional)) requirements as well.
• Ensure delivery with business expectation (entrance criteria within user stories).
• Participate in application evolution by contributing technical enhancement to the applications
• Provide UAT support.
• Provide third level support to production issues from assigned application within defined SLA.
• Develop business as well as technical knowledge on the applications.
• Lead project review meetings to gain business confidence.

Skill Profile

 • ServiceNow ITSM & CSM certification required & ITIL certification preferable.

Telecom background with interaction of customer over self-service portal.

 • Strong troubleshooting skills on ServiceNow platform and capability to propose new solutions to business problem.
• Ability to build up good intimacy and partnership with the business

You bring passion, energy, taste for exploration and adaptability. You seek the opportunity to expand your knowledge and develop new skills.

 What We Offer

 • Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
• Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
• Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
• Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
• Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.

 Only Your Skills Matter

 Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neurotype, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. As a Senior ServiceNow Architect, you will lead the strategic design and technical governance of the ServiceNow ITOM suite. You will bridge the gap between business outcomes and technical execution, driving automation that reduces manual overhead and enhances service availability.

 • Architecture & Design: Define the end-to-end technical architecture for the ITOM suite, specifically focusing on Discovery, Service Mapping, and Event Management.
• Discovery Optimization: Design, configure, and troubleshoot Discovery schedules, MID Server clusters, and complex classification patterns across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) and on-premises environments.
• CMDB Governance: Enforce CSDM (Common Service Data Model) standards to ensure data integrity, service-aware relationships, and accurate impact analysis.
• Integration Leadership: Architect seamless integrations between ServiceNow and third-party monitoring tools
• Technical Advisory: Lead "Discovery Health Checks," conduct POCs for new features (e.g., Agent Client Collector), and provide mentorship to junior developers and administrators.

 Required Skills & Qualifications

 • Experience: 10+ years in ServiceNow, with at least 5 years specifically focused on ITOM implementation.
• Scripting: Proficient in JavaScript (GlideScript), Regex, and PowerShell/Shell scripting for custom discovery patterns
• Certified System Administrator (CSA) & Certified Application Developer (CAD).
• CIS – Discovery (Mandatory).
• CIS – Event Management or Service Mapping (Strongly Preferred).
• Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or Certified Master Architect (CMA) is a significant plus.

Role : ServiceNow Architect 
 Experienc e : 8-12yrs
 Locati on : Hyderabad / Chennai
 

 Primary Skill 
 • ls Own architecture for a shared ServiceNow MSP instance with Domain Separation: tenant onboarding, data/record segregation, ACL design, and scoped app boundaries.
• Define and govern multi‑tenant operating model: domain hierarchies, domain‑aware tables, process segregation, cross‑domain access controls, and guardrails.
• Lead end‑to‑end solutioning across ITSM (Incident/Problem/Change/Request), CMDB/CSDM, ITOM (Discovery, Service Mapping, Event) as applicable.
• Design integrations via Integration Hub/Service Bridge, MID Servers, REST/SOAP, JDBC, email, webhooks; establish patterns for retries, idempotency, pagination, and monitoring.
• Establish instance strategy: sub‑prod tiers (DEV/TEST/QA/UAT/PROD), cloning cadence, update set strategy, Source Control (Git), ATF automation, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Plan and drive upgrades & patching (Family Releases): pre‑assessment, skip‑list review, regression testing, and post‑upgrade fixes with minimal tenant disruption.
• Architect CMDB health: reconciliation, identification rules, de‑duplication, class model governance, data quality dashboards.
• Security & Compliance: SSO (SAML/OAuth), encryption, secrets, RBAC/ACLs, domain‑aware security policies, audit logs, and regulatory alignment.
• Performance & Reliability: query optimization, table/index strategy, async jobs, background scripts control, and platform limits (flows/jobs).
• Service Portal/Workspace architecture, theming and component reuse; UX guardrails and accessibility considerations.
• Lead technical reviews, mentorship, and design sign‑offs; produce HLD/LLD, ADRs, and reusable reference architectures.

 

 Roles & Responsibilities 
 • Lead discovery workshops; capture functional & non‑functional requirements (security, availability, performance, compliance) per tenant/domain.
• Author MSP architecture: domain model, ACL strategy, integration architecture, CMDB/CSDM blueprint, and support model.
• Define tenant onboarding/offboarding process: catalog, domains, roles, groups, data segregation, and guardrail checks.
• Establish DevSecOps for ServiceNow: branching, update sets hygiene, Source Control, ATF suites, CI/CD gates, and rollback procedures.
• Plan upgrades/patches with change governance; coordinate cloning schedules; execute regression plans with ATF/automated tests.
• Own CMDB health and CSDM alignment; set measurable targets and remediation plans.
• Run integration governance: credentials vaulting, MID server sizing, error handling, and observability dashboards.
• Publish SoWs, design artifacts (HLD/LLD), RACI, and operational runbooks; chair design reviews and CAB/ARB where needed.
• Coach developers/admins; enforce coding standards, performance best practices, and secure configurations.
• Engage with vendors and ServiceNow store/app providers; evaluate add‑ons and manage licensing.
• Report KPIs to leadership; continuously improve MSP maturity (automation, reliability, cost).

 Position Summary 

 Cyber 

 Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

 Position Summary

 Level: Manager 

 In this role, you will architect scalable ServiceNow solutions that automate vulnerability intake, prioritization, remediation, and reporting across complex environments. You will work across VR, SIR, CMDB, and ITSM processes to help organizations reduce risk, improve remediation outcomes, and strengthen platform governance.

 Work you'll do

 As an Engineering Manager II on the Cyber Risk Services team, you will be responsible for:

 • Designing and implementing ServiceNow Vulnerability Response solutions, including workflows for vulnerability ingestion, prioritization, assignment, remediation, and closure

 The team

 Deloitte’s Cyber Risk Services help our clients to be secure, vigilant, and resilient in the face of an ever-increasing array of cyber threats and vulnerabilities. Our services help organizations to address, in a timely manner, pervasive issues, such as identity theft, data security breaches, data leakage, cyber security, and system outages across organizations of various sizes and industries with the goal of enabling ongoing, secure, and reliable operations across the enterprise.

 Qualifications

 Required:

 • 8+ years of ServiceNow experience in administration, development, or platform engineering roles
• 7+ years of experience in ServiceNow design, development, and architecture

• Experience with ServiceNow configuration, JavaScript or Glide scripting, REST APIs, and MID Server management
• Experience with ServiceNow CMDB, Information Technology Service Management, and Common Service Data Model
• Experience integrating vulnerability scanners such as Qualys, Tenable, or Rapid7 with ServiceNow Vulnerability Response
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related field

 • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification
• ServiceNow Certified Application Developer certification
• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist certification in SecOps or Vulnerability Response
• CISSP or CISM certification
• Experience with Performance Analytics, Integration Hub, or Application Portfolio Management
• Experience with vulnerability management frameworks such as NIST or ISO 27001

 Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

 Shift Timings: General Shift

CMDB Data Quality & Health

Data Attestation & Compliance

ServiceNow CMDB & CSDM Management

 • Define and maintain CI classes, attributes, relationships, naming conventions, and lifecycle states.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

 Experience

 Preferred Qualifications

 Job Title: ServiceNow Developer

 Job Description

 Appbay Technologies is seeking a skilled ServiceNow Developer to join our growing technology team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in developing, configuring, and customizing solutions on the ServiceNow platform. You will be responsible for implementing and enhancing ServiceNow applications, workflows, integrations, and automation solutions to support business and IT operations while ensuring scalability, performance, and best practices.

 Key Responsibilities

 • Develop, configure, and customize applications and modules on the ServiceNow platform.
• Design and implement workflows, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, catalog items, and service catalog solutions.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders, analysts, and project teams to gather requirements and deliver effective ServiceNow solutions.
• Develop and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and external systems using REST APIs, SOAP services, and integration frameworks.
• Configure and support ITSM processes including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Knowledge Management.
• Troubleshoot and resolve application issues, performance bottlenecks, and platform-related challenges.
• Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, testing, and deployment activities.
• Create and maintain technical documentation, configuration guides, and development artifacts.
• Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to ServiceNow development standards and best practices.
• Stay updated with the latest ServiceNow releases, features, and industry trends.

 Required Skills

 • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
• 2–4 years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development and administration.
• Strong knowledge of ServiceNow platform architecture and development concepts.
• Experience working with ITSM modules such as Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Catalog.
• Proficiency in JavaScript, ServiceNow scripting, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Script Includes, and Flow Designer.
• Experience with ServiceNow integrations using REST APIs, SOAP services, and IntegrationHub.
• Understanding of relational databases and data modeling concepts.
• Experience with ServiceNow workflows, automation, and process optimization.
• Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

 Preferred Skills

 • Experience with modules such as ITOM, HRSD, CSM, GRC, Asset Management, or Service Portal.
• Knowledge of IntegrationHub, MID Server, and Discovery.
• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
• Experience with source control systems such as Git.
• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification is preferred.
• ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) certification is an added advantage.
• Exposure to cloud platforms and enterprise application integrations.

 Why Join Us?

 • Be part of an innovative and rapidly growing technology organization.
• Work on enterprise-scale ServiceNow implementation and transformation projects.
• Gain exposure to advanced ServiceNow modules and emerging platform capabilities.
• Continuous learning opportunities, certification support, and career growth.
• Collaborative work culture with experienced professionals and technology leaders.
• Opportunity to contribute to impactful digital transformation initiatives for global clients.

If you’re passionate about ServiceNow development, workflow automation, and delivering enterprise solutions, we’d love to hear from you! Share your details below and let’s build the future together.

Company Description

 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 Job Description

 We are seeking an experienced and visionary ServiceNow Solutions Architect to lead the design and implementation of innovative ServiceNow solutions that drive efficiency, automation, and value across our organization. As a ServiceNow Solutions Architect, you will be a key technical leader, responsible for translating business requirements into robust and scalable ServiceNow architectures. You will collaborate with stakeholders at all levels, guide development teams, and ensure that our ServiceNow platform strategy aligns with our overall enterprise goals.

 Key Responsibilities

 • Strategic Solution Design: Architect end-to-end solutions on the ServiceNow platform, encompassing various modules (ITSM, CMDB/Discovery, Integration Hub, ITOM, HRSD, SecOps, App Engine, SPM, ITAM, CSM, EAM, etc.) to meet complex business needs.
• Technical Leadership & Governance: Provide expert technical guidance, mentorship, and oversight to ServiceNow developers and administrators. Establish and enforce development best practices, coding standards, and platform governance.
• Platform Roadmap & Innovation: Contribute to the ServiceNow platform roadmap, staying current with new platform capabilities, industry trends, and emerging technologies. Identify opportunities for innovation and platform optimization.
• Requirements Analysis & Translation: Collaborate with business analysts, process owners, and stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and translate business requirements into detailed technical designs and solution specifications.
• Integration Architecture: Design and oversee the implementation of integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems, ensuring data integrity, security, and optimal performance.
• Platform Governance, Risk Management & Best Practices: Define, champion, and enforce ServiceNow architectural standards, design patterns, development best practices, and platform governance policies across the organization. Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable, and performant. Identify and mitigate architectural risks.
• CMDB & CSDM Strategy: Play a pivotal role in defining and maturing our Configuration Management Database (CMDB) and Common Service Data Model (CSDM) strategy and implementation.
• Proof of Concepts & Prototyping: Lead and develop proof-of-concept (PoC) initiatives and prototypes to evaluate new ServiceNow features or complex solution designs.
• Quality Assurance & Testing: Define and support testing strategies to ensure solutions are high-quality, reliable, and meet business requirements.
• Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive architectural documentation, including solution designs, technical specifications, and decision logs.
• Stakeholder Management: Effectively communicate complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership. Build strong relationships with key stakeholders.

 Qualifications

 • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent experience will be considered.
• Experience: Minimum 10+ years of direct, hands-on experience with the ServiceNow platform.
• Proven track record in a ServiceNow Architect role, designing and delivering complex, enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions.
• ServiceNow Certifications (Essential):
• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
• ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
• At least three ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications (e.g., ITSM, ITOM, Discovery,HRSD, SPM, Service Mapping).

 Technical Skills

 • Deep understanding of the ServiceNow platform architecture, including data model, security, workflow, and application development.
• Expertise in ServiceNow scripting (JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Actions, Script Includes).
• Proficiency with ServiceNow integration capabilities (IntegrationHub, eBonding, REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server).
• Strong knowledge of CMDB/CSDM principles and implementation best practices.
• Experience with ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF).
• Familiarity with web technologies (HTML, CSS, Angular, Jelly).

 Additional Information

 Preferred Qualifications:

 • ServiceNow Certified Master Architect (CMA) or Certified Technical Architect (CTA).
• Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
• Knowledge of ITIL v3/v4 frameworks (Foundation or higher certification is a plus).
• Experience in specific industries relevant to Nielsen.
• Experience with Performance Analytics, Reporting, and Dashboards in ServiceNow.
